address: Reşitpaşa Mahallesi, Kongre Caddesi No:15/A, Sarıyer, Istanbul, 34467, Türkiye
bio: Asude and Bahadir are ambassadors for Anatolian cuisine. She will gladly tell you all about their concept while providing attentive service and bringing refreshing mocktails to your table (no alcohol served here). He works to a single set menu that celebrates traditional flavours. Variations of tomato and pepper are a common theme in his diverse range of dishes, whether vegetarian or meat-based. His less-is-more approach is exemplified by the millefeuille of dry figs with Aegean olive oil, or the refined combination of rosewater, saffron, currants and rice. Herise Istanbul is one of a kind.
